name: currency-input
description: A locale-aware money input that groups digits as the user types, respects the locale's decimal separator, and re-formats on blur with the currency's natural fraction digits. The currency symbol is rendered inside the input as a prefix (derived via Intl.NumberFormat.formatToParts). Optional right-side dropdown lets the user switch currency. Works controlled or uncontrolled with `value` + `onValueChange`.
